animal detail state has no serious accessibility violations
permissions error recovery state has no serious accessibility violations
create animal, record a weight, move bucket — profile reflects all

suites.title: frontend proxy auth and team API contracts

specs.title: proxies the liveness and database-readiness probes
persists password changes and returns exact me/export data through the proxy
deletes a separate registered non-owner and makes its login unusable
persists worker resets and the full custom-role create/update/delete lifecycle
animal status mutation returns and persists the requested lifecycle facts
breeding GET, live-pregnancy GET, and pregnancy abort agree on one record
health batch lookup/preview and restriction clearance round-trip their data
task GET returns the created duty and skip remains visible on readback
feeding setting and recipe mix are reflected by plan, inventory, and finished stock
finance correction returns the replacement and preserves the voided source audit
herd snapshot and scenario GET/PATCH/compare/DELETE stay consistent
owner signs in, sees the full nav, and logout returns to /login
unauthenticated visit to an app page redirects to /login
wrong password shows an error and stays on /login
signIn helper lands on the dashboard
authenticated shell fits supported narrow widths and hands off navigation focus
sign-out propagates between farmless tabs without a farm storage key
doe is bred, confirmed pregnant via ultrasound, moves to PREGNANCY_EARLY
a provisioned worker without finance.view is refused 403 on the finance API
another farm's owner cannot read this farm's animal: uniform 404s
switching farms renders none of the previous farm's cached data
feeding plan shows the 40/20/40 shift split and records a dispense
adding an expense transaction lists it in the ledger
reports page renders herd summary, breeding performance and mortality
record a vaccine event — event log, profile health card, schedule badge
overdue pregnancy is kidded with twins — kids become animals, doe moves to RECOVERY
every nav item loads its page without errors
logged-out direct-URL access redirects every app page to /login
renders its sections and replays the toy herd for one week
a row without a tag is reported inline, blocks the run, and never reaches the API
an owner transfers a separate farm to a password-rotated member through Team
renders its sections, plans a sale target, and keeps owner access
a target in the plan's start month is rejected inline and blocks the run
a new batch stubs animals into QUARANTINE with the 45-day task schedule
a new user registers, creates a farm and reaches its dashboard
scoreboard → queue → detail → confirm → conflict toast, all stubbed at the API
defaults + herd events run end-to-end; save and re-run as a scenario
an event month beyond the horizon blocks the run with an inline error
farm calibration and all decision analyses render responsively
auto duties are form-linked; a completed duty lands in awaiting verification
owner completes and verifies a cleaning duty — it lands in Completed as VERIFIED
rejected duty is sent back to pending with the note visible
owner adds a worker, changes their role and toggles them inactive/active
task-only password worker completes first password rotation on the worker board
owner creates and resets a PIN worker through Team and pins the tablet through the UI
